#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

long modExp(long base, long exp, long mod) {
    long result = 1;
    long cur = base % mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * cur) % mod;
        cur = (cur * cur) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

vector<long> invs(int n, long p) {
    vector<long> res(n);
    res[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < n; i++) {
        res[i] = (p - (p / i) * res[p % i] % p) % p;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int totalIntervals, thresholdCount, multiplier;
    cin >> totalIntervals >> thresholdCount >> multiplier;

    const int N = 2 * totalIntervals + 3;
    const long MOD = 998244353;

    vector<long> inverses = invs(N, MOD);
    vector<vector<long>> dpTable(2 * totalIntervals + 1, vector<long>(totalIntervals + 1, 0));
    // Initialize DP
    dpTable[0][1] = 1;

    for (int step = 1; step < 2 * totalIntervals; step++) {
        int maxPrev = min(2 * totalIntervals - step, step);
        int maxNext = min(2 * totalIntervals - step - 1, step + 1);
        for (int activeCount = 0; activeCount <= maxPrev; activeCount++) {
            long currentVal = dpTable[step - 1][activeCount];
            if (currentVal != 0) {
                if (activeCount > 0) {
                    long val = (currentVal * activeCount) % MOD;
                    val = (val * inverses[2 * totalIntervals - step]) % MOD;
                    dpTable[step][activeCount - 1] = (dpTable[step][activeCount - 1] + val) % MOD;
                }
                if (activeCount < maxNext) {
                    long val = (currentVal * (2 * totalIntervals - step - activeCount)) % MOD;
                    val = (val * inverses[2 * totalIntervals - step]) % MOD;
                    dpTable[step][activeCount + 1] = (dpTable[step][activeCount + 1] + val) % MOD;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    long answer = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 2 * totalIntervals; i++) {
        for (int j = thresholdCount; j <= totalIntervals; j++) {
            answer = (answer + dpTable[i][j]) % MOD;
        }
    }
    answer = (answer * multiplier) % MOD;
    answer = (answer * inverses[2 * totalIntervals + 1]) % MOD;

    cout << answer << "\n";

    return 0;
}
